newsitem.title: UK: NatWest appoints structured finance heads.
newsitem.headline: NatWest appoints structured finance heads.

text.p: NatWest Markets, the investment banking arm of National Westminster Bank, has appointed structured finance directors in Europe and Asia, it said in a statement on Thursday.

Peter Phillips will be managing director responsible for structured finance Europe from October 1. He will be based in Paris, and was previously overseeing the development of structured finance business in Asia.
The statement said Phillips would be developing business in project finance, trade finance, leasing and receivables structures.
Ai-Gek Beh was promoted to director structured finance, Singapore, and John Lane and Rachel Goh to assistant director and manager forfaiting respectively.
Alun Williams will return to London from Singapore to take up the position of director business management for structured finance, the statement said.

Earlier this month NatWest announced a major overhaul of its NatWest Markets division, breaking the Global Financial Markets (GFM) group away from its equities, debt and corporate advisory arms. -- Aline van Duyn, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7748
